mapper.select: select id, user_id, problem_id, submission_id, title, content, status, like_count, view_count, create_time, update_time from solution where user_id = #{userId}

select id, user_id, problem_id, submission_id, title, content, status, like_count, view_count, create_time, update_time from solution where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 order by create_time desc limit #{limit}

select s.id as id, s.problem_id as problem_id, p.title as problem_title, s.title as title, s.user_id as author_id, u.nickname as author, u.avatar as avatar, s.like_count as like_count, s.view_count as view_count, s.submission_id as related_submission_id, s.create_time as create_time, s.update_time as update_time from solution s join problem p on p.id = s.problem_id join user u on u.id = s.user_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.status = 1 order by s.create_time desc
select count(*) from solution where problem_id = #{problemId}
